title: Practice Listening With Small Choices
core_idea: Intuition can be strengthened like a quiet muscle by noticing your inner response in small, low-stakes choices before trusting it with bigger ones.
text: We often only ask our intuition for help when something big is at stake. A move, a relationship, a new job. But a quiet voice is hard to hear for the first time in a storm. What if you practised on small things instead? Which street to walk down. Which tea to make. Whether to call a friend today or tomorrow. Pause for one breath, notice what feels lighter, and simply follow it. Nothing much depends on it, and that's the point. Over time, you may find you recognise that gentle pull more easily, so when a bigger choice comes, it already feels familiar.
description: A gentle idea for strengthening intuition: practise listening to it in small, everyday choices first.
